notes.title: Full version update
notes.notes:
This update requires re-downloading the game, the original downloaded players please uninstall and re-download, the previous archive can not be used oh ~
1. Characters will no longer gain experience after reaching level 300, if they gain a lot of experience at level 299, they will exceed level 300, which is normal.
2.Steam players can add groups to receive free sponsorship code, used to receive [sponsorship exclusive magic weapon] in the game, of course, there is no magic weapon can be cleared, do not like to add groups does not affect the normal game.
3. The game value was redesigned, and the difficulty selection was changed to a uniform difficulty
4. Optimized some avatar and dialog text, and fixed some bugs
5. Open all chapters, the game duration is 8-12 hours.

notes.notes:
